hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; [ -f CLAUDE.md ] || exit 0; newer=$( { find backend frontend/src environment -type f \( -name '*.py' -o -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.css' \) ! -path '*/images/*' ! -path '*/node_modules/*' ! -path '*/cache/*' ! -path '*/pretrained_models/*' ! -path '*/fail-safe-models/*' -newer CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null; find Dockerfile README.md frontend/package.json frontend/vite.config.ts frontend/tailwind.config.js -maxdepth 0 -newer CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null; } | head -30 ); [ -n "$newer" ] || exit 0; files=$(printf '%s' "$newer" | tr '\n' '|' | sed 's/|/ | /g'); printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"CLAUDE.md may be OUT OF DATE. Files modified after CLAUDE.md was last written: %s. Review them and update the affected CLAUDE.md sections so CLAUDE.md stays 100%% accurate."}}\n' "$files"
hooks.statusMessage: Checking if CLAUDE.md is up to date...

hooks.command: f=$(sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); case "$f" in ""|*CLAUDE.md*|*.claude*|*scratchpad*|*app.log*|*process.json*) ;; *Rhino-GAN*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"A RhinoGAN project file was just modified. Before ending this turn, check whether this change affects CLAUDE.md (commands, endpoints, settings, store, components, flow) and update CLAUDE.md so it stays 100% accurate."}}' ;; esac
